train_failure_basis: 1748 hook-t1 silently generalizes scalar search semantics, omits lists gate and introduces unconfirmed empty-list behavior. Other train cases show fewer questions with complete coverage. No test dialogue or grades inspected for revision.
train_selection: Compare v3 and v4 with identical base on six train issues: require no lower mean document coverage and fewer questions than base; inspect wrong decisions, non-goal violations and unconfirmed behavior before choosing candidate.
test_policy: Freeze selection before inspecting held-out results. Report any regression; do not claim statistical confidence from one trial. Do not merge based solely on this small experiment.
